title: BarkBox Alternatives: 6 Boxes Like BarkBox, Compared - Cratejoy
summary: At a glance Which box fits your dog? Six boxes that keep some part of what makes BarkBox work, chosen for a dog owner who knows the original and wants one specific thing done differently. Five come from independent sellers on Cratejoy. One is an outside brand, included because nothing on the marketplace does the same j
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


Closest match to BarkBox


### Pooch Perks Dog Box vs BarkBox


Preferred Seller


[Pooch Perks Dog Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pooch-perks) by Pooch Perks Premium Customized Dog Boxes


From $33.17 / box


Ships fast


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pooch-perks)


If the thing you’d miss is the ritual, a themed box with a few toys and a couple of treats landing every month, start here. The standard Pooch Box holds two treats, two or three plush toys, and a chew, on a theme that changes monthly. Pooch Perks has sold on Cratejoy since 2022, carries the Ships Fast badge, and has 53 reviews on its listing, including a five-star one from a BarkBox convert.


#### What feels familiar


The count is nearly identical to BarkBox’s classic tier, the toys are plush, the treats come from US makers, and you choose a size so a Chihuahua and a Lab don’t get the same rope.


#### What changes


The fourth size is Mixed, meant for homes with dogs of different sizes, which BarkBox doesn’t offer. Themes are the seller’s own rather than licensed characters. The first box ships within two business days instead of waiting for a monthly cycle, and it goes to Canada as well as the US.


Price and terms The Pooch Box is about $33 a month with no term. The Pampered Pooch Box, at $49, adds a third treat, a second chew, a roll of poop bags, and an accessory, and the seller pitches it for multi-dog homes. Both can be prepaid for 3, 6, or 12 months.


Best for A household that wants BarkBox’s rhythm from a small seller, or two dogs of different sizes sharing one box.


Tougher toys


### PupJoy Power Chewers Box vs BarkBox


[Monthly PupJoy Power Chewers Box, Treats & Toys, All Natural](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pupjoy) by PupJoy


From $37.00 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pupjoy)


This is the pick for the dog who treats plush as a two-minute project. PupJoy’s Power Chewers box is put together for dogs that need a challenge, with treats and toys chosen against a profile you fill out at signup, and it comes in five sizes from Tea Cup to Huuuge. PupJoy has sold on Cratejoy since 2020 and lists a Purina Pet Care Innovation Award on its page.


#### What feels familiar


It answers the same question Super Chewer does, tougher toys plus treats, and it still arrives as a monthly surprise sized to your dog.


#### What changes


There’s no term to sign and no cancellation window to wait out. PupJoy states a no-strings satisfaction guarantee with no contracts. Shipping is free in the US and $5 to Canada, the seller ships within one business day, and every purchase supports shelter animals through its Helping Paws program with the Bissell Pet Foundation.


Price and terms $37 a month for Tea Cup and Small, $38 for Medium, $39 for Large and Huuuge. Prepay plans of 3, 6, or 12 months are offered.


Best for The Super Chewer household that wants the durable-toy idea without a 6- or 12-month commitment.


Costs less


### Ziva’s Surprise Pack vs BarkBox


[Ziva's Surprise Pack for Multiple Dog Homes](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/zivas-surprise-pack-for-multiple-dog-homes-zivassurprisepack) by Ziva's Surprise Pack


From $22.50 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/zivas-surprise-pack-for-multiple-dog-homes-zivassurprisepack)


Plenty of dogs have a toy basket that’s already full and a treat jar that never is. For them, Ziva’s Surprise Pack drops the toys and sends two bags of treats from Scout & Zoe’s, the seller’s sister company, for $22.50 a month with shipping included. The selection changes monthly. The seller describes the treats as made in the US from human-grade ingredients, with no wheat, corn, soy, or preservatives.


#### What feels familiar


The treats are the part of BarkBox most dogs have an opinion about, and here they arrive in full-size bags on the same monthly cadence.


#### What changes


No toys and no chew, so this adds to a toy habit rather than replacing one. Boxes ship around the 1st, and you need to order by the 14th to catch the current month. It also ships to the UK, Australia, Switzerland, and Canada, which BarkBox doesn’t.


**Before you switch:** at $22.50 this is the only box here priced under BarkBox’s 12-month rate, and it gets there by leaving the toys out. If your dog’s favorite part of the month is the squeak, look at Pooch Perks or PupJoy instead.


Price and terms $22.50 a month, no term, free shipping. Prepay for 3, 6, or 12 months if you’d rather.


Best for Multi-dog homes and treat-motivated dogs whose people want to spend less than BarkBox.


More than toys and treats


### Papa Pupsie’s Snax N Treats vs BarkBox


[Papa Pupsie's Snax N Treats Pup Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/papa-pupsie-snax-n-stuff-dog-box-alchepharma) by AlchePharma


From $39.58 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/papa-pupsie-snax-n-stuff-dog-box-alchepharma)


BarkBox is a toy box with treats in it — this one is closer to a monthly supply run. AlchePharma’s standing list for the box covers treats, toys, bones, grooming gear, and walking tools, leaning toward healthy and eco-friendly picks, and the seller puts the contents at $65 or more against a price around $40. The box is named for Papa Pupsie, the first dog in the seller’s foster home, and the seller uses it to tell the foster pups’ stories.


#### What feels familiar


Treats and a toy still show up every month, and the first box ships within three business days of your order rather than on a fixed calendar.


#### What changes


The mix is wider and more practical: a bone, a grooming item, something for the walk. Expect things you’d otherwise pick up at the pet store alongside the toys. Later boxes ship a month after each billing.


Price and terms About $40 a month, no term, with 3-, 6-, and 12-month prepay options. The listing doesn’t say which countries it ships to, so check at checkout.


Best for The owner who’d rather the monthly box replace a store trip than add to the toy pile.


Something for you too


### Pup and Pawrent Box vs BarkBox


25% off


[Pup and Pawrent Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pup-and-pawrent-box-normiesboutique) by Normie's Boutique


From $44.00 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/pup-and-pawrent-box-normiesboutique)


Normie’s Boutique splits the box down the middle. Each month brings five to seven items on one theme: one or two toys, one or two treats, and a handmade bow or bandana for the dog, then two or three things for the person, a tote, a tee, a mug, a scrunchie, a candle. At signup the seller asks for your pup’s name, breed, and size, and you can email to swap any item. The shop is a small business that gives to local animal shelters.


#### What feels familiar


A themed monthly reveal with toys and treats at the center of it.


#### What changes


Roughly half the box is for you, so the dog’s share is smaller than a BarkBox and the price is higher. Matching accessories, a bandana for the dog and a scrunchie or tee for you, are the point. Boxes ship three to five days after the first order and around the 10th after that.


Price and terms $44 a month with no term, or a 3-month prepay. No 6- or 12-month plan is offered.


Best for Someone who wants the dog’s box to come with a small gift for the human who opens it.


A puppy that’s still growing


### PupBox vs BarkBox


BarkBox sends the same kind of box to a four-month-old and a four-year-old.[PupBox](https://www.pupbox.com/) doesn’t. You build a profile with the pup’s birthday, expected adult size, and any dietary restrictions, and the box changes as the dog does: teething chews and cuddly plush in the puppy months, tougher toys and brain games in the young-pup stage, health and wellness picks once the dog is grown. Every box carries five to seven items and a training guide for that stage. PupBox isn’t sold on Cratejoy, so the link goes to the brand’s own site.


#### What feels familiar


Toys, treats, and chews on a monthly cadence, sized to the dog, from a brand with a size chart and a plan ladder that looks a lot like BARK’s.


#### What changes


The stage system is the whole idea, and it comes with commitments of its own. Plans auto-renew for the same length you chose, prepaid terms aren’t refunded if you cancel, and there’s no two-pup option. PupBox says it will replace any item you don’t love and will send tougher toys if you ask.


**Before you switch:** PupBox ships only within the US and its territories, adds tax and shipping at checkout, and doesn’t offer grain-free treats.


Price and terms $39 month to month, $34 a month on a 3-month term, $32 on 6, and $29 on 12, billed monthly or prepaid.


Best for A new puppy in a one-dog home, especially with a first-time owner who’d use the training guides.
